title: Inheritance as an Admission Test for LLM Prompt Merge Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.29023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are often improved by iterating until a fixed verifier is done. Once that verifier saturates, the loop has nothing left to climb. We instead score agents against the current population, and a frozen panel records whether anyone got better. The panel mean can rise inside the seeds by elimination alone. We therefore count a run as training only when its final mean beats the best generation-zero member. A merge is admitted only when the child moves toward the donor, past the child the same operator produces at zero dose, and the lower confidence bound on that movement reaches half the requested dose. That is the admission test. A detectable shortfall rejects the operator, and the test is otherwise undetermined. We keep realised fitness \phi as the selector and reference performance \theta as the unused ruler. Every measurement uses gemini-3.1-flash-lite on one negotiation task, and no fixed-oracle arm was r

translated_title: 继承作为大语言模型提示词合并算子的准入测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常通过不断迭代来改进，直到固定的验证器达到饱和。一旦验证器饱和，迭代循环便再无可攀之处。我们转而将智能体与当前种群进行对比评分，并由一个冻结的评审面板记录是否有人真正变得更好。仅凭淘汰机制，面板均值就可能仅在各个种子内部上升。因此，只有当一次运行的最终均值超越第零代最佳成员时，我们才将其计为有效的训练。只有当合并产生的子代朝供体方向移动、且超过同一算子在零剂量下所生成的子代，同时该移动量的置信下界达到所请求剂量的一半时，该合并才被准入。这就是准入测试。若检测到明显不足，则拒绝该算子，否则测试结果为未定。我们将实际适应度φ保留为选择器，将参考性能θ作为一把未被使用的标尺。所有测量均在单一谈判任务上使用gemini-3.1-flash-lite完成，且未使用固定预言机分支。
tldr: 提出以“继承”作为LLM提示词合并算子的准入测试——只有当合并子代确实朝供体方向移动且其移动量的置信下界达到请求剂量的一半时才接受该合并，从而区分种群层面的真实提升与仅由淘汰机制造成的虚假进步。
en_tdlr: Proposes "inheritance" as an admission test for LLM prompt merge operators—accepting a merge only when the child demonstrably moves toward the donor with the confidence lower bound reaching half the requested dose, thereby distinguishing real population-level improvement from spurious gains caused by elimination alone.
